Subject: Filling up the post of Advisor (Coordination & Monitoring), National Water Mission
(NWM), New Delhi under Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga
Rejuvenation -reg.

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text:
This is with reference to this office circular dated 14.01.2026, 18.02.2026, 19.03.2026,
29.04.2026, 11.06.2026 and 14.07.2026 (copy enclosed) on the above subject.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text: 2. The last date for submission of application for the above referred circular is extended upto 17.09.2026. Nominations are to be routed through DoPT online interface (DoPT website>>EO Division>>Apply for posts of CSS, CVO and Others >>SUPREMO > [choose Non-CSS category through SUPREMO link: https://supremo.nic.in) for those officers who have not yet applied for any other posts online this year. Nominations as well as all correspondence on the subject may be routed through email id: dirsm@nic.in and useosm1@nic.in only. This office is not accepting any physical communication.

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text: 1. Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation (Ms Archana Varma, Secretary), New Delhi.

#/texts/13.label: paragraph
